baseline_models.focus_anchor: أرسلناك ... لتتلوا عليهم الذي أوحينا إليك ... قل
baseline_models.mechanism: Sending installs a carrier between a hidden disclosure and its audible following-out before hearers. The mission is therefore a relay, not merely arrival in a population: concealed knowledge is carried, recited in sequence, and made public speech even while it is covered over by rejection.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message image makes sending the first link of a carried-speech relay.
Following and succession make recitation the next link that tracks what was given before it.
Knowledge conveyed in concealment supplies the hidden input that public recitation externalizes.
Utterance by speech supplies the relay's explicit public output.
Covering names the hearers' response as an overlay on the transmitted content, not a break in its delivery.

changed_reading.before: A messenger is sent to tell a people a revelation.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagrams a hidden-to-public relay: disclosure is deposited, carried, followed out in recitation, and voiced even when hearers cover it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: في أمة قد خلت من قبلها أمم لتتلوا ... وإليه متاب
baseline_models.mechanism: The double community term, elapsed predecessors, temporal before, and following recitation form a succession mechanism. A community is a temporary receiving station after earlier stations; the messenger's own return gives the chain an endpoint beyond any one community.

activation_trace.role: A group gathered by a common feature supplies each communal receiving station in the sequence.
The passing of ages and peoples makes prior communities elapsed stations rather than a static backdrop.
Temporal precedence orders the earlier communities ahead of the present one.
Following in succession lets recitation continue the sequence rather than restart it.
The supplied split-root image of an affair becoming settled and continuous cautiously colors the stated return as the chain's stable endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The ayah compares the present nation with vanished nations.
changed_reading.after: It places this community inside a recurring transmission history: peoples pass, recitation follows, and the messenger orients beyond the whole sequence to a stable return.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وهم يكفرون بالرحمن قل هو ربي لا إله إلا هو عليه توكلت
baseline_models.mechanism: The rejected object is specifically mercy. Covering overlays that merciful relation, while the answer names one owner-caretaker, excludes rival worship-objects, and hands the affair to another. The declaration regulates agency under rejection rather than merely supplying a creed.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering makes disbelief an obscuring layer over what follows.
Tender mercy and beneficence identify what the covering response fails to recognize.
Gradual care, repair, and completion make Lordship the sustaining action beneath the rejection.
The worship-object image excludes competing centers of final allegiance.
Entrusting an affair to another transfers outcome-control away from the messenger.

changed_reading.before: The people deny a divine name, and the messenger responds with faith and trust.
changed_reading.after: Their denial covers an active mercy; the response recenters care, worship, and outcome-control in one Lord so refusal does not recruit the messenger into controlling belief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus community can be read as a maternal carrier of concealed disclosure. Contextual carrying, womb, diminution, increase, and exact measure make reception a hidden developmental process: communal disbelief may cover what is being carried without proving that no formation is occurring.

activation_trace.role: The mother-and-nurturer image gives the two community terms a possible maternal-container register.
Hidden delivery supplies content that can be carried before it becomes publicly legible.
The womb as a house of growth gives the divine title a supplied but exploratory gestational resonance.
Hidden carrying and fruit provide the material state assigned to revelation within the communal body.
Diminution supplies one possible trajectory of what is carried.
The explicit womb occurrence activates the same branch image latent in the focus title.
Increase and growth supply the competing trajectory, preserving more than one reception outcome.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit constrains both decrease and growth.

structural_cues: 13:8 clusters female carrying, wombs, diminution, increase, and exact measure before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maternal, womb, hidden-carrying, decrease, growth, and measure images; I map their process onto an umma carrying revelation. The live alternative is that 13:8 concerns divine knowledge of gestation without modeling communal reception.

changed_reading.before: A community either hears the recitation and believes or rejects it.
changed_reading.after: The community may also be a measured gestational medium in which hidden disclosure decreases, grows, or matures beneath the visible surface of refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nonresponse to a call, imagined material feats of a recitation, divine ownership of authority, and the explicit division between delivery and accounting define a hard agency boundary. The focus trust is operational: the messenger must carry and voice disclosure but cannot own response, spectacular efficacy, or reckoning.

activation_trace.role: Entrusting the affair supplies the focus-side transfer of outcome-control.
The reply-to-speech image is negated in the source sequence, supplying a call that does not secure response.
Arrival at a goal is twice staged as unattained, separating attempted reach from controlled result.
Reading and recitation identify the same medium whose imagined physical efficacy is tested.
Displacement supplies the counterfactual feat of moving fixed mountains.
Severing supplies the counterfactual feat of cutting the earth.
Intelligible speech between parties supplies the counterfactual feat of addressing the dead.
Authority and sovereignty reserve the affair behind those imagined effects for God.
Delivery of a message defines the messenger's positive assignment.
Counting and accounting define the retained divine assignment.

structural_cues: 13:14 stages an unanswered call and failed reach.
13:31 places spectacular recitational counterfactuals before divine ownership of the affair.
13:40 assigns delivery to the addressee and accounting to the speaker's side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonresponse, failed reach, recitational counterfactuals, divine authority, delivery, and accounting; I infer a division of agency that explains focus trust. A live alternative is that recitation can mediate effects while their timing and production still remain outside messenger control.

changed_reading.before: Trust consoles the messenger when his audience refuses to believe.
changed_reading.after: Trust enforces the commission's scope: he owns faithful relay, while response, extraordinary effect, and account remain with the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The water parable turns the verbal relay into a capacity-shaped flow. Disclosure enters communal channels in measured amounts; rejection can be read as conspicuous surface foam, while what benefits can remain below it. This preserves a second model beside the binary hearing-versus-refusal model.

activation_trace.role: Following movement lets recitation function as a continuing current from disclosure to hearers.
Covering supplies the focus anchor for a visible layer that can obscure rather than exhaust what lies beneath.
Delivery by watering and pouring supplies the material transfer medium.
Flowing floodwater supplies movement through the receiving terrain.
A valley as the flood's channel supplies differently shaped communal receivers.
Each thing reaching its measure makes receiver-capacity govern the amount carried.
Floating foam supplies a loud surface product that is not identical with the enduring current.
Remaining with patient stability supplies the below-surface persistence of benefit.

structural_cues: 13:17 orders water, channels, capacity, carried foam, its removal, and the remaining benefit as one process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, channel, measure, surface foam, and persistence; I assign revelation, communities, rejection, and retained benefit to those positions. The live alternative is that the parable concerns truth and falsehood generally, not this mission specifically.

changed_reading.before: Recitation meets a uniformly rejecting community.
changed_reading.after: Recitation can enter communal channels according to capacity; visible rejection may be transient surface excess while less visible benefit remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus return is activated as repeated reorientation rather than only a terminal repentance. Turning back, heart-settling through recollection, inward reversal, and good return form a feedback loop: trust releases the affair, remembrance settles the center, and return renews direction.

activation_trace.role: Reliance supplies the release of control that begins the return loop.
The supplied split-root image of stability and continuation cautiously adds settled persistence to the stated return.
Habitual return and recurring turn supply iteration rather than a single endpoint.
Stillness and reassurance supply the state produced by repeated reorientation.
Turning and destination place the heart itself inside the return mechanism.
Bringing something back to presence after absence supplies the loop's recurrent operation.
Return to a place supplies an explicit neighboring destination image.

structural_cues: 13:27-29 sequence turning back, repeated heart-settling by remembrance, and a good return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring return, remembrance, heart-turning, settling, and destination; I connect them as a feedback loop behind matab. The live alternative is a linear sequence of conversion, present calm, and final reward.

changed_reading.before: My return means a final return or a single act of repentance.
changed_reading.after: My return can also name a repeated practice of releasing control, re-presenting the Lord, turning the heart, and regaining settled direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later near-parallel converts the focus first-person declaration into operating instructions. Command, worship, call, and return define the office; judgment and explicit expression define its communicative form; the warning against following desire explains why trust is needed under audience pressure.

activation_trace.role: Spoken utterance supplies the focus declaration that the later sequence operationalizes.
Exclusive worship anchors the declaration to the commission's object rather than private sentiment.
Entrusting the affair protects the commissioned speaker from taking audience desire as controller.
Binding request supplies the explicit mandate behind the focus declaration.
Submissive worship states the mandated act corresponding to no deity but Him.
Calling by speech turns declaration outward toward an audience.
Return to a destination mirrors and clarifies the direction of the focus matab.
Judgment supplies the normative form in which the disclosure is sent down.
Clarification and explicit expression make intelligibility part of the commissioned form.
Following in another's track supplies the prohibited transfer of direction.
Inclination of desire identifies the audience pressure the speaker must not follow.

structural_cues: 13:36 closely repeats command, exclusive worship, outward call, and return.
13:37 immediately joins sent-down Arabic judgment to a warning against following audience desires.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near-parallel mandate and a following-versus-desire warning; I read them back into the focus creed as an operational constraint. The live alternative is that the focus remains primarily devotional self-positioning with only indirect vocational force.

changed_reading.before: Say is followed by a personal confession of monotheism, trust, and repentance.
changed_reading.after: The confession is the commission's rule of operation: worship, call clearly, return, and refuse to let audience desire redirect the entrusted message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The succession of communities expands into a transmission architecture: messengers recur before the present one, human lines spread, signs require authorization, each term has an inscription, mutable traces are erased or established, and a maternal source-book remains. The focus community becomes one time-bounded instantiation under a stable source rather than an isolated audience.

activation_trace.role: A mother as origin, collector, and reference supplies the source-center latent in the repeated community root.
Writing and inscription make disclosure compatible with an archival transmission model.
Successive bands supply recurrence across multiple messenger occurrences in one source.
Temporal precedence explicitly places those missions before the focus mission.
Small scattered propagation supplies human continuity through descendants alongside message continuity.
Authorization constrains when a messenger can bring a sign.
A fixed temporal limit gives each transmission instance a bounded term.
An inscription that fixes judgment or measure records the term.
Erasure supplies controlled removal of a trace or entry.
Durable establishment supplies controlled retention against erasure.
The explicit mother occurrence activates origin, collector, and reference as the stable source relation.
Ordered letters and written object supply the book-side of the retained source.

structural_cues: 13:38 sequences prior messengers, descendants, authorized signs, terms, and books.
13:39 immediately sequences erasure, establishment, and the mother of the book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, propagation, authorization, term, inscription, erasure, establishment, and maternal source; I infer an archive with time-bounded instantiations. The materially live alternative is a legal-decree mechanism rather than textual or communal versioning.

changed_reading.before: The current community simply follows communities that disappeared.
changed_reading.after: It is one authorized, time-bounded transmission instance within a revisable historical record held against a stable maternal source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing denial directly contests the focus's first predicate, sent. Its answer does not make audience acceptance the credential; sufficient divine witness and knowledge of the book externalize accreditation. Focus trust thus includes reliance on a witness outside the contested exchange.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message supply the commissioned identity later placed under denial.
Public utterance supplies the response mode reused when accreditation is contested.
The sufficient guardian who stands over an entrusted affair supplies the reliance structure for external accreditation.
State-negating denial directly contests that the addressee is sent.
Standing over an affair until sufficiency is reached makes divine testimony enough without audience ratification.
Knowledgeable declaration supplies the external witness to the commission.
Disclosure to a knower supplies a second knowledge-based accreditation point.
The written book supplies the durable object against which that knowledge is oriented.

structural_cues: 13:43 closes the window by negating sent status, then answering with sufficiency, witness, knowledge, and book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct denial and external witness structures; I infer that focus trust includes accreditation independent of hearer assent. The live alternative is that the final witness answers only a separate polemic and does not define the emotional mechanics of 13:30.

changed_reading.before: The messenger trusts God while his audience rejects the message.
changed_reading.after: He also entrusts the very validation of his commission to sufficient witnesses outside the audience's contested verdict.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the supplied split mapping from the recitation root to a form-distant toppling branch. It remains anchored in تتلوا and is activated by 13:31's recitation, mountain displacement, earth-cutting, and speech-to-the-dead sequence; downstream prose should present it only as latent rhetorical pressure, not as the lexical meaning of recite or a claim of literal physical efficacy.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary following and succession retain the secure recitation anchor.
The split-root image of throwing or toppling supplies the odd pressure latent in the same focus root mapping.
Reading and recitation identify the contextual operator for the imagined material feats.
A high solid mass supplies what would have to be displaced.
Displacement supplies the motion imposed on that fixed mass.
Severing supplies a second disruptive image alongside toppling.
Intelligible speech supplies the verbal force imagined as reaching even the dead.

changed_reading.before: Recitation follows and voices prior revelation.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the supplied split mapping, recitation also exerts toppling rhetorical pressure on what presents itself as fixed, though its physical realization is explicitly not assigned to the messenger.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ق ل ل target supplied for قل. It remains anchored in the imperative, trust, and 13:40's delivery/account division; downstream prose should qualify it as split-root wordplay that colors the command as a finite burden, never as a replacement for the ordinary meaning say.

activation_trace.role: Spoken utterance preserves the direct lexical function of the command.
The supplied split-root image of carrying a load and rising with it colors saying as bearing a bounded charge.
Entrusting the affair supplies release of the load beyond the speaker's assignment.
Message delivery defines where the carried charge is discharged.
Accounting locates the remaining burden on the divine side of the division.

changed_reading.before: Say introduces the required verbal answer.
changed_reading.after: Say can additionally feel like taking up a finite communicative load: carry it to delivery, then entrust the account rather than continuing to bear it.

strongest_changes: The context turns trust from consolation into an agency boundary: the messenger owns relay, while response, extraordinary efficacy, accounting, and accreditation remain elsewhere.
Womb-and-measure and water-and-valley sequences preserve coexisting material readings of communal reception as hidden growth and capacity-shaped flow rather than immediate assent alone.
Neighboring return, remembrance, heart-settling, and mirrored commission language make matab both recurrent reorientation and the operational direction of the call.
Prior messengers, bounded terms, inscription, erasure, establishment, and mother-book recast passing communities as time-bounded transmissions held against a stable source.
summary.what_was_special: The sharpest latent activation came from the adjacency of covering and the Merciful, then from maternal, hydraulic, archival, and split-root images that changed the mission without displacing its focus anchors. Distinct outcome-boundary, gestational, flow, return-loop, commission, archive, and witness readings remain live together.
remaining_uncertainties: The gestational and hydraulic mechanisms may characterize divine knowledge or truth generally rather than this mission specifically.
The archive model depends on a reader-supplied versioning analogy; a legal decree and record mechanism remains equally live.

The focus ت و ب inventory lacks a direct ordinary return branch, so recurrent return is anchored by the surface construction and nearby ن و ب and ء و ب cues while the supplied split branch contributes only stability.
The two split-root outliers are deliberately form-distant and should remain qualified as latent pressure, not lexical substitution.
